item.title: Scandal Rocks CBS News As Bari Weiss Asks Journalists To Do Journalism
item.description: U.S. — CBS News has descended into turmoil after new Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss asked the journalists employed there to do journalism.

item.title: Woman Beginning To Suspect Husband Didn't Start Shopping Till Yesterday As She Opens Can Of Dinty Moore Beef Stew
item.description: GREENVILLE, SC — Local woman Ashlynn Bagley began to suspect that her husband did all his Christmas shopping yesterday after she opened a present containing a can of Dinty Moore beef stew.

item.title: 'Do You Think This Is Him?' Asks Shepherd Pointing To Baby With Glowing Halo
item.description: BETHLEHEM — Shepherds began to believe they may have found the Christ child after discovering a baby with a glowing halo hovering above its head.

item.title: Oh No! Russian Forces Invade Alaska While NORAD Distracted Tracking Santa
item.description: ANCHORAGE, AK — A military spokesman confirmed Wednesday that Russian forces launched a successful sneak attack on Alaska while everyone at North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) was busy tracking Santa's sleigh.
